_readme: Dealroom showcase under Experience. Slides come from 'Eglantine Dupuy - Dealroom Research Portfolio.pdf' (pages rendered to assets/img/dealroom/slides/slide-NN). 'links' holds LinkedIn featured items (article, podcasts, reports): type, title, url, description, thumbnail. Run python scripts/render.py after editing.

slides.alt: Cover: The State of European Foodtech 2024, Dealroom.co and Five Seasons Ventures, March 2024

reports.title: Food for Climate: Sustainable Food- & AgTech in Europe

slides.alt: Cover: Food for Climate, the State of the Sustainable Food- and AgTech Ecosystem in Europe, FoodLabs and Dealroom.co, June 2024
Chart: European alternative protein startups raised $365M in 2023, broken down by plant-based, lab-grown, fermentation and mycelium
Cover: Growth Equity in European Healthtech, MTIP and Dealroom.co, June 2024
